plain_description.what: An engineering change. Whether a question is used for building the tree or for the arena is now computed from the question's own content, with a check on every row in both Kotlin and Python. Benchmark runs refuse trees not built on training-only data, and old toggle flags are retired.
plain_description.why: Earlier incidents showed arena questions leaking into tree building. This makes the split a fixed function that can be checked, not a setting someone can change.
plain_description.information: It guarantees that the build and test sets stay separate for new work. Result: done. The invariants were verified and the pinned pools reproduce exactly. A later correction: the trees built earlier do NOT meet the training-only rule (some held-out texts were inside them). The worst-case effect on routing figures is at most about 1.3 points (combined pool) and 2 points (MMLU-Pro). Whether to rebuild or disclose is still the author's decision.
